description: A bladedancer trained in the shadow groves of Thornhaven, who strikes with the speed of a diving hawk. Their twin blades flash like autumn leaves in a storm.
icon_hint: crossed daggers over a red slashing arc with speed lines
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy striker assassin class. Dark leather strap border with brass buckle corners and red stitching. Charcoal-grey brushed leather center with faint crossed-blade watermark. Small crimson slash marks at bottom. Color palette: dark brown leather, deep crimson, brass. No characters, no text.
